correctness.rationale: For the exact Zhang–Yan–Shi I=V=0 stationary BVP, fixed positive parameters, arbitrary finite advection and strictly positive phytoplankton invasion eigenvalue, integrating the two zero-flux biomass terms and the exact Lambert–Beer photon budget bounds kappa*S in L1 uniformly across ALL positive equilibria. A positive bounded Green kernel for mu_p-D converts this into a common L-infinity bound; ODE and Robin boundary estimates give C2 precompactness. Any zero limit contradicts the strictly positive principal invasion eigenvalue on normalization. Strictly decreasing light feedback and the Wronskian force the limiting scalar positive solution to be unique, with Hsu–Lou existence as prior input. Linearized Wronskian W=z'u-zu' obeys W'=omega/d_p W -(A_H/d_p)u^2 j, j=integral(z)>0, giving F_a=d_p W(X)/u(X)>0; nutrient shooting derivative G_b=alpha>0, G_a=0. The 2x2 shooting Jacobian is invertible, local implicit-function uniqueness and global compactness exclude remote coupled steady branches for sufficiently large finite kappa. Differentiating in epsilon=1/kappa yields S=kappa^-1 u_*+O(kappa^-2), N=N0-kappa^-1 n_*+O(kappa^-2) in C2, n_* the explicit positive Neumann–Robin Green integral. Not a theorem on all finite kappa, infected equilibria or nonlinear stability; numerical solve_bvp of one parameter set corroborates but is not the proof.
